scope: Single-file import, saved-dataset inventory and metadata reopen

checks: real: automatic empty-library open and actual storage status
real: import dialog opens with keyboard, handles Escape, restores focus
real: UI imports little-endian STDF, shows retained counts, device-attempt terminology and SHA-256
real: renamed identical contents resolve to the original dataset
real: unsupported extension, multiple-file drop and malformed STDF do not publish a ready row
real: each import resets previous progress; active import remains visible on Escape; cooperative cancellation settles without a dataset
real: hostile filename is literal text; populated library fits 360px and 390px viewports
real: reload reopens existing catalog and dataset without selecting the source again
real: closing dataset details with Escape or its close button returns keyboard focus to the original name/arrow action after rows rerender
real: Library tools uses same-tab navigation; browser Back reopens the library
real: second tab reports exclusive-owner BUSY and Retry succeeds after owner closes
test-only mocked catalog: bounded 100-entry loading, 25-row pagination, full-inventory path search, name and size sorting, no-results state
test-only mocked catalog: unavailable dataset remains in the library with recovery guidance
test-only delayed metadata: closing details during an operation restores row focus after it settles
test-only mocked client: unsupported storage and corrupt-open failures are actionable without reset
